meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style file-based planning for complex tasks. Creates and maintains task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md under .kiro/plan/. Use when planning, breaking down work, resuming a multi-step task, tracking phases, or restoring context after compaction. Trigger phrases include start planning, continue task, resume work, current phase, restore context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文件管理复杂任务的分步计划与进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需分步骤完成复杂工作并记录进展
copy.tagline_en: Manage complex task plans and progress with files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down complex work into steps and track progress

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为复杂任务创建并维护三个文件：task_plan.md（任务计划）、findings.md（研究发现）和 progress.md（进度日志），保存在 .kiro/plan/ 文件夹中。每次对话前，它会读取这些文件来恢复上下文，确保工作不丢失。
howto.when: 当你说出“开始规划”、“继续任务”、“恢复工作”、“当前阶段”或“恢复上下文”等触发词时，或者当你要求规划、分解工作、跟踪阶段时，技能会激活。

say.text: 开始规划：帮我写一个 Python 脚本的详细计划。
say.note: Claude 会创建 task_plan.md 并开始规划。

say.text: 继续任务：从上次中断的地方继续。
say.note: Claude 会读取进度文件并恢复工作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates and maintains three files for complex tasks: task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md under .kiro/plan/. It reads these files before each turn to restore context, ensuring work is not lost.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like "start planning", "continue task", "resume work", "current phase", or "restore context", or when you ask to plan, break down work, or track phases.

say_en.text: Start planning: create a detailed plan for a Python script.
say_en.note: Claude creates task_plan.md and begins planning.

say_en.text: Continue task: resume from where I left off.
say_en.note: Claude reads progress files and resumes work.
Claude reads task_plan.md to tell you the current phase.
